resources.string: Open an official source to choose an app, then install it using Android. AIOS does not download or install these apps automatically. Browser and document opening use Android defaults or the system app chooser; speech output uses your selected system TTS engine. Each app and model has its own terms.

Opening websites and browser automation are different capabilities. Automation still requires a compatible Chromium browser with its CDP endpoint available. Installing an arbitrary browser does not enable automation.
